<section class="about" id="about">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-label">About</div>
    <p>I came to data because I like problems where the answer isn't obvious until you clean the thing up and look at it properly. What I care about is whether an analysis actually changes a decision — on my Storage Star internship, the sensitivity analysis mattered more to the people reading my report than the fitted coefficients did.</p>
    <p>Right now I'm looking for <mark>analytics</mark> <mark>strategy</mark> <mark>engineering</mark> and <mark>BDR</mark> roles where I can keep working on problems with real stakes.</p>
